description_en: Restarts one or more ECS instances. You can specify whether to force restart instances and set different batch operation modes
description_zh: 本接口用于重启一台或多台ECS实例，支持您通过参数来选择是否强制重启和设置不同的批量操作模式
kebab_example: aliyun ecs reboot-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RebootInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run without restarting the instance. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and instance status. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, `DRYRUN.SUCCESS` is returned.
If the BatchOptimization parameter is set to `SuccessFirst`, the dry run result for `DryRun=true` returns only `DRYRUN.SUCCESS`.

false: performs a dry run and sends the request. After the check passes, the instance is restarted.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会重启实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回`DRYRUN.SUCCESS`。
如果参数`BatchOptimization`被设置为`SuccessFirst`，对应的`DryRun=true`的预检结果只会返回`DRYRUN.SUCCESS`。

false：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接重启实例。

默认值：false
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在的地域。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force restart the instance. Valid values:

true: forces a restart. This is equivalent to a power-off operation. Cached data that has not been written to storage devices is lost.

false: performs a normal restart.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制重启。取值范围：

true：强制重启。相当于典型的断电操作，所有未写入存储设备的缓存数据会丢失。

false：正常重启。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_reboot

parameters.help_en:
The batch operation mode. Valid values:

AllTogether: In this mode, a success message is returned if all instances are restarted. If any instance fails validation, all instances fail to restart and an error message is returned.

SuccessFirst: In this mode, each instance is restarted separately. The response includes the operation result for each instance.

Default value: AllTogether
parameters.help_zh:
设置批量操作模式。取值范围：

AllTogether：该模式下，如果实例全部重启成功，则返回成功信息；如果任意一个实例校验不通过，则所有实例重启失败，并返回失败信息。

SuccessFirst：该模式下，分别重启每个实例，返回结果包含每个实例的操作结果信息。

默认值：AllTogether
parameters.name: batch_optimization

parameters.help_en: The instance ID array. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: instance_id

InstanceResponse.description_en: The array of InstanceResponse objects that contains the status before and after the operation and the operation result for each instance
InstanceResponse.description_zh: 由InstanceResponse组成的数组格式，返回每个实例操作的前后状态及操作结果

Code.description_en: The error code of the instance operation result. A return value of 200 indicates success. For more information, see the error codes section
Code.description_zh: 实例操作结果错误码。返回值为200表示操作成功。更多信息，请参见下文错误码列表

CurrentStatus.description_en: The current status of the instance

Message.description_en: The error message of the instance operation. A return value of Success indicates that the operation is successful. For more information, see the error codes section
Message.description_zh: 实例操作返回错误信息。返回值为Success表示操作成功。更多信息，请参见下文错误码列表

PreviousStatus.description_en: The status of the instance before the operation
